title: Law 4.2/4.5 Probe: 8-Block ResBN & Isomorphic 4D Conv2d 1x1 Twin
intuition: Trains an 8-block branch-RMSNorm residual trunk (D=128, w=128) on a 64-mode R^128 mixture alongside its mathematically isomorphic 4D `Conv2d(1x1)` twin on identical initial weights and batches (conv1x1_sw1_ratio <= 1.05).
failure_mode: Optimizers that apply polar/spectral conditioning to 2D Linear matrices but skip or mishandle 4D Conv2d tensors diverge sharply between the two mathematically identical parameterizations.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence diagnostic probe (500 updates, R^128 64-mode mixture).
